propositions: Accepted /rerun and recheck-review requests exist only in process-local asyncio queue; process loss discards them while Gerrit retains the old vote and SQLite retains the voted row, causing reconciliation to skip the revision.

The repair writes LLM-Review: 0 to the exact revision, verifies no nonzero vote remains across all accounts, then enqueues/returns the forced event; the reset-emitted comment-added event is the durable marker enabling reconciliation to recover after restart.
Reconciliation must query Gerrit before trusting local dedup; a definitive no-vote read clears the exact stale voted row, while Gerrit errors preserve dedup and hold the cursor back.

Contributor text in recheck-review requests cannot select label values or mint PASS/BLOCK votes; only the privileged reset operation writes the fixed neutral value 0, and reply posts remain label-free.
